description: The frozen pool carries its full instruction text inside each record. The harness adds no wrapper, no system prompt, no few-shot exemplars and no chain-of-thought scaffold.

assembly_contract.rule: visible = dict(record['input']) with the banned keys removed; when visible['prompt'] is a string it is sent verbatim, otherwise the canonical JSON of visible is sent
assembly_contract.response_postprocessing: fenced code blocks are stripped before grading for the json_exact, topological_order and python_unit scorers; no other rewriting is permitted

checks: expected_output must not appear in the serialised model input
the grader block must not appear in the serialised model input
the exact serialised hidden reference value must not appear verbatim in the model input

current_implementation_reference.why_not_pinned: the counted-qualification harness still has to gain the EVAL-131 overhead accounting fields (wall_ms, token counts, attempt counts, exact model config). What is frozen here is the prompt contract above, which any counted harness must satisfy; pinning the current harness file would block that required work.

binding: CapabilityProfile.prompt_version and every counted observation must carry g13-prompt-v1
change_policy: any change to the assembly contract or the banned-key list is breaking: mint g13-prompt-v2 and a new pool freeze version
